+"""Load xdg2 configuration files."""
+
+import os
+
+from lamina.errors import LaminaError
+from lamina.loader.core import loads
+from lamina.model import Document
+
+
+def load_xdg2(path: str, *, strict: bool = True, skip: list[str] | None = None) -> Document:
+    skip = list(skip or [])
+    skip.append(path)
+    fh = open(path, encoding="utf-8")
+    file_text = fh.read()
+    if strict and not file_text.strip():
+        raise LaminaError(f"empty configuration: {path}", 0, 1)
+    fh.close()
+    doc = loads(file_text, base_dir=os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(path)), strict=False)
+    doc.source = path
+    return doc

+import pytest
+
+from lamina.loader.xdg2 import load_xdg2
+
+
+def test_xdg2_loads(write):
+    path = write("a_xdg2.conf", "[a]\nx = 1\n")
+    assert load_xdg2(path).get("a.x") == "1"
+
+
+def test_xdg2_empty_strict(write):
+    path = write("e_xdg2.conf", "")
+    with pytest.raises(Exception):
+        load_xdg2(path, strict=True)
+
+
+def test_xdg2_empty_lenient(write):
+    path = write("l_xdg2.conf", "")
+    assert load_xdg2(path, strict=False).sections() == []
